items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: At the time I was studying too, with Bernard Purdie... And he also helped me put together how to secure a publishing company... given them one tune and learn the ropes.

ctx.x: At the time I was studying too, with Bernard Purdie. And I remember him saying — with Bernard Purdie you sit at the drum set, first of all you can never wear sneakers, he’d throw you out. He always said shoes. And he never played the drums, he would just circle like a shark around the prey. And then he would preach. And he’d come out with these pearls of wisdom every like thirty seconds for an hour. And all of a sudden you’d hear him like, “It’s not getting the gig, it’s keeping the gig.” And he’d stop and he’d…
